title: How To Export Member Categories
text:
## How To Export Member Categories
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000058144
Existing member categories can be exported as a CSV file under My Members >> Member Categories >> Member Category Actions dropdown >> Export Categories :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171252454/original/QwfNKS-Q9kbjrFh6QRE1yOIVlsXfA706hA.png?1764550876 | alt: ]
Clicking on this option will display a confirmation module:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090677219/original/v7Ep6z4ITkppoHi45J8OZ6lTklkd6mVKSQ.png?1617116555 | alt: ]
When the process is completed, a Success message will be displayed and the categories file would be downloaded:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093194718/original/p2FAHdRq9oevCH-0vRbvBG2eh92TAzO2Ig.png?1622056616 | alt: ]
What is included in this export: This file exports the category structure (Top, Sub, and Sub-Sub category names, IDs, and settings). It does not include a list of members or which categories they are assigned to.
If looking to export member data, review " How to Export Members " documentation.
Good to know: This action simply creates a safe backup/copy of your categories. The live website categories will remain exactly as they are.
